crossRefs.note: lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow…
Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

translations.web: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.
translations.bsb: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
translations.kjv: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
translations.asv: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
